row: Dr. Schell of Bow Bottom Veterinary hospital in Calgary educates Clients and the public on various Veterinary Medicine topics.  She also performs many demos to help clients with home care.  Enjoy and share!  For more information visit www.bowbottomvet.com or call (403) 278-1984.  Like us on Facebook, to stay up to date with our videos and tips!  www.facebook.com/bowbottomvet This channel is to help educate only.  We do not respond to medical questions, we suggest you refer to your Veterinarian for recommendations for your pet health care needs.
